'''2011 German National Championship Floris de Vries LS Center Of Tyranny''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Floris de Vries]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Center Of Tyranny / A Liberated World|VB7-L-centeroftyranny-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Broquen Squadron
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
